sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2008 Lamborghini Murciélago LP640 Coupe, finished in black with a black interior. The odometer on this Murciélago currently displays approximately 20,800 miles. The attached Carfax history report shows that this LP640 has been owned in Florida, Georgia, and California since new. Factory equipment includes 18-inch Hercules wheels, a front axle lift system, xenon headlights, LED tail lights, scissor doors, active rear air intakes, quilted leather upholstery with white contrast stitching, a Kenwood touchscreen head unit, and carbon fiber engine bay trim. Modifications reported by the seller include an aftermarket titanium exhaust system, an aftermarket rear spoiler, a hard-wired laser jammer/radar detector system, window tint, and paint protection film. Launched in 2007, the Murcielago LP640 received multiple updates with the most notable being the engine. Lamborghini increased the displacement of the V12 to 6.5-liters, which in turn gave the LP640 a near 60 horsepower bump. The E-Gear transmission received a revised clutch and a launch control setting. On the exterior, the LP640 was also given new, more aggressive front and rear bumpers, LED tail lights, and a single-exit exhaust. Power comes from a 6.5-liter V12 engine, rated at 631 horsepower and 487 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via a 6-speed E-Gear automated manual transmission and a permanent all-wheel drive system.
